DECISIONS.q: Directus, or Appsmith / Retool, as the tool over the database
DECISIONS.position: Neither. Directus is out. What must sit on the app's own database (admin over the app tables, edits to client data) is built by Spinach as the admin panel. Every other item Directus held (content, templates, app config, SKU cards) goes to Zoho: Creator or a CRM custom module for non-sensitive content and config. No Directus, Appsmith or Retool anywhere.
DECISIONS.position_v01: Directus first: it covers the Financial Data views, the CMS, roles, and the activity log in one free tool. Trial for two days against the real schema; add Appsmith only if the pre-call view needs a composed screen Directus cannot show.
